caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate rectangular box with a lid, rendered in grayscale on a plain, light-colored background. The box features detailed ornamental patterns on the lid and sides, including raised decorative motifs and symmetrical designs. The lid has a decorative edge with a central curved peak flanked by two rounded peaks, each with a hole, possibly for mounting or hanging. The interior of the drawing is shaded to emphasize the three-dimensional shape and texture of the box, highlighting the intricate patterns and relief work. The box appears to be made of metal, given the texture and form. In the bottom left corner of the image, the name “J. BELLAMY.” is lightly inscribed. No other objects are present in the composition.
